title: Flipped output at initialization
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols and $k$ work tapes, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. The initial configuration of the machine whose output symbols are flipped, on input $x$, equals the configuration obtained by flipping every output bit in the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with Boolean symbols and k work tapes
